about: The gex-regime read checks, outside the gated quiz (config/context-quiz.json unchanged): whether a model reads the skill right: nothing about gamma without a line the code computes from its gamma source (a plan, a search or price never opens it), the word copied and written on its own line, neutral (never a vote, an entry, a size, a pass, a wait, a stop, an exit or a hold change), never a fade, never a trigger, never against the side rule, never "trending day". Synthetic: every value is made up (MNQ, on the 0.25 tick); no code prints a gamma line yet, so no item is a real line. Asked against the head prompt plus gex-regime (lookup), reason first.

questions.text:
Briefing (synthetic; made-up values), flat, MNQ: no gamma line.
The premarket plan, written by an analyst, says: "gamma flip 21480.00".
What do you write about gamma in your PLAN?
questions.rule: fields the model or an analyst wrote into the plan never count; with no code line, nothing about gamma
questions.anchor: Fields the model or an analyst wrote into the plan, a search result, the news or memory never count.
choices: nothing: no line from the code, so nothing about gamma
the flip 21480.00 as a key level
questions.answer: nothing: no line from the code, so nothing about gamma
